provenance.method: Transcript-verified complete reading order; initial reading displayed from zero. A lost first word in both canonical contextual windows is recovered only when two prompt-free fixed windows exactly recognize every word of the same complete source reading (at least eight words and thirty letters), all words have positive spans and likelihood, first-word edges agree with the full transcript within 0.5 seconds, and an independent original medium contextual word agrees on both edges. Early held-word candidates outside strict transcript-onset bounds are documented; conflicting in-range contextual words reject recovery. Both models and tokenizers are pinned. Other boundaries retain original contextual checks and original lyrics are preserved.
